newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: FAI sees large parcel put through market.
newsitem.headline: FAI sees large parcel put through market.

text.p: Insurance group FAI Insurances Ltd saw a parcel of 20.17 million shares, about 6.5 percent of its ordinary listed capital, put through the market before the start of trade on Monday.
The parcel was handled by Sydney broker Maquarie Equities at a price of 61 cents per share, one cent higher than their close on Friday.
By 10.50 a.m. (0050 GMT), FAI sahres were two cents firmer at 62 cents.
Dealers said the shares were either sold or bought by an offshore investor.
FAI's two major offshore stakeholders are investment bank, J.P. Morgan and fund group Phillips & Drew Funds Management.
"I am unaware of who the buyer or who the seller is at this stage," the company's managing director, Rodney Adler told Reuters.
